title: Breast Cancer: Medication Use to Reduce Risk: women at increased risk for breast cancer aged 35 years or older

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians offer to prescribe risk-reducing medications, such as tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors, to women who are at increased risk for breast cancer and at low risk for adverse medication effects.

action: Offer to prescribe risk-reducing medication (e.g., tamoxifen, raloxifene, or aromatase inhibitors) to eligible women
